added.name: RouterPlus
added.long_description:
RouterPlus is a marketplace for AI inference. We find the right AI model for a team's product, then get it served at the team's scale, at the best price.

Most teams that run AI in production pay for a top model on every task, when a cheaper model can do most of the work. The same model can also cost twice as much depending on which provider runs it, and many providers fail at peak traffic.

RouterPlus tests models on a team's own traffic and recommends one. Providers then compete for the workload. We check that the chosen provider can hold the team's real peak, and we keep a second provider ready as a backup. Teams call the model through one API.

Our largest customer runs 3 million agent conversations a day on RouterPlus.
added.one_liner: Marketplace for AI inference: the right model at the best price

Reflex is the operating system for building mission-critical enterprise applications.

Today’s enterprise stack is fragmented. Shipping an app requires stitching together multiple tools and coordinating across multiple roles. Reflex replaces that complexity with a single, unified platform to build, deploy, and manage production applications end-to-end.

We empower teams to own the entire lifecycle of their apps — from idea to production — without needing specialized infrastructure, DevOps, or platform teams. We do this by providing solid, reusable abstractions at both the framework and infrastructure layers. Because we own the underlying open-source framework and the platform it runs on, we can manage the full lifecycle of the application seamlessly.

With Reflex, teams securely connect to company data, use AI to build standardized applications on top of our open-source framework, and deploy with a single click to share across their organization.

We’re replacing the fragmented enterprise stack — and the organizational bottlenecks that come with it.

Founded by Alek Petuskey and Nikhil Rao, Reflex has powered over 1 million applications, earned 28,000+ GitHub stars, and is used by 30% of Fortune 500 companies for internal tools and data-driven applications.
long_description.after:
For decades, businesses have adapted to software that wasn’t built for them. Teams pay for features they don’t need, go without the ones they do, and fill the gaps with spreadsheets, emails, and manual work. AI flips the equation. Now, software can be built around your business.

Reflex brings AI and engineering expertise to your business without requiring you to become a software company. We work alongside your team to identify where better software can make the biggest difference, build on or replace your existing systems, and help you put it to work.

Our platform gives every app a shared foundation, making your software easier to connect, maintain, and improve. As your business evolves, your software can evolve with it.

That foundation is Reflex, our open-source framework for building full-stack web apps entirely in Python. With 1M+ apps built, approximately 29,000 GitHub stars, and usage by 30% of the Fortune 500, Reflex gives developers a shared foundation for building and extending applications, with source code they can inspect, customize, and run themselves.

one_liner.before: The operating system for building mission-critical enterprise apps.
one_liner.after: Build the software you wish existed.

long_description.before: Zatanna creates APIs for software that doesn't have any, by reverse engineering back ends of web-based cloud and on-prem software.
long_description.after: Zatanna is building the infrastructure for AI to interact with software. AI agents are increasingly capable of performing work that was previously done by humans, but they're still constrained by software interfaces designed for people. Today, agents rely heavily on clicking buttons, navigating pages, and interacting with UIs to get things done. At Zatanna, we're changing that by reverse engineering applications to turn their underlying workflows and actions into reliable, read-and-write APIs, regardless of whether those applications offer APIs themselves.

0.security is an applied AI research lab helping developers, AI-native startups, and enterprises to continuously find & fix security risks 24/7.

Our autonomous cybersecurity team has found & fixed previously unknown vulnerabilities in operating systems, government code and software powering more than 3 billion devices.

We work with EY, big pharma, financial services, AI-native startups and defense organisations to secure systems at the pace & depth needed to defend against AI-powered attackers.
long_description.after:
0.security builds an autonomous offensive security team that finds and fixes vulnerabilities as fast as AI writes code and attackers exploit it.

We've found and fixed dozens of previously unknown vulnerabilities (0-days) in government software across multiple countries and in software powering more than 3 billion devices. Today we work with EY (Ernst & Young), leading tech companies and defense organizations.

Our AI agents hack into any software, verify every vulnerability they find, and ship the fix autonomously. They run 24/7 across the full stack, from web apps and dependencies down to operating systems and the Linux kernel.

We offer two products: 0cloud, where developer teams connect their repos and get security handled 24/7, and our open-source harness, which we deploy for enterprises and critical infrastructure providers.
